name: Kasatani Youko
source:
She is Rie's older sister and a 22-year-old female college student.

She takes care of Rie in place of her parents who live abroad for work.

She has a calm personality and is always temperate and kind.
Unlike her sister Rie, she is fond of the main character and treats him like a younger brother.

The main character also admires her and looks up to her like an older sister.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/jutsu2/chara05.html]the official site[/url]]
